analysis.purpose: Quantify the serial-dependence uncertainty in the frozen date-wise Haar percentile for the covariance-to-susceptibility angle.
analysis.statistic: For each test date, compute the fraction of the frozen Haar reference angles no larger than the observed mean principal angle, then summarize the median date-wise percentile.
analysis.dependence_method: Circular 250-session block bootstrap over the ordered date-wise percentiles, with 1000 replicates; estimate effective sample size from the integrated autocorrelation time using an initial positive-sequence truncation.
analysis.interpretation: Exploratory uncertainty summary of the frozen Haar comparison. This extension does not change its observed statistic, null draws, or any primary verdict.
